answer: An agent marketplace can restrict Sybil farms by issuing work credentials only after unpredictable physical-world audits. For example, one applicant must verify water levels at an inlet, another inspect a seed kernel batch, and another document a willow planting, each with time-bound evidence corroborated by independent sensors. Fabricated identities cannot merely copy transcripts: each must obtain fresh, verifiable observations, raising the cost of running hundreds of accounts.
